benefits.text: Aegyosal Pencil helps create a plump under-eye (aegyosal) effect and define the eye area more clearly in just one step. The soft, smooth creamy pencil glides easily on the skin, gives natural color and can be layered to increase definition while keeping a smooth layer of color. The thin, lightweight formula adheres well around the eye area, helping the aegyosal look fresh for many hours and helping limit smudging, fading or settling into streaks. The design has a finger-brush blending tip that helps blend the color more softly for a natural effect.

howToUse.text: Twist up just enough product and draw it on the under-eye area, the eyelid crease or the inner corner of the eye. Use the blending tip at the end of the pencil to blend lightly so the color melts naturally into the skin. You can combine a light shade, a blush shade and a shading shade to create a more defined aegyosal.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
